subject.title: Workspaces: add stream and computed bindings

question: Should Workspaces permanently expose presence and sessions.changed to approved workspace bindings, adopt the implicit-first outputBinding migration, and ship stream/computed bindings while command bindings remain separately deferred?
rationale: Tests can verify enforcement but cannot decide the intended long-term custom-widget data boundary, persisted upgrade policy, or whether the partial canonical issue scope should be accepted.

options.title: Approve bounded contract after proof
options.body: Accept the two-event allowlist and migration after current-head live and upgrade evidence is added, while tracking command bindings separately.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Ship computed bindings and explicit output selection first, deferring all gateway stream exposure to a separately reviewed change.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want another persisted binding/API surface in the bundled Workspaces plugin.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded contract after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the two-event allowlist and migration after current-head live and upgrade evidence is added, while tracking command bindings separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Workspaces architecture and security model entered main through their merged integration PR.
